summary.en: Mud, idealism, traffic jams—and a morning set that still rewires how America hears its anthem.
summary.zh: 泥、理想、堵车——以及一场清晨演出，仍在改写美国听见国歌的方式。

whyEpic.en: Woodstock is less a clean concert than a national rumor that came true. Hendrix's late set becomes the image everyone argues about: beauty, noise, protest, and hangover in the same feedback loop.
whyEpic.zh: 伍德斯托克与其说是干净的演唱会，不如说是成真的国家传言。Hendrix 偏晚的那场，变成人人都要争的画面：美、噪音、抗议、宿醉，在同一圈 feedback 里。

rightsNote.en: Editorial only—no full concert embeds. Use licensed editions if you want the footage.
rightsNote.zh: 仅编辑介绍——不嵌整场。想看影像请走正版。
